h1: Custom Cup Lead Times: Approval, Production & Transit
lead: Separate design and sample approval from production and transit. Ask what starts each milestone and which approvals can stop it; a single headline lead time does not describe every development route or destination.
html:
Give Your Next Sourcing Decision a Clearer Direction

Bring these decisions back to your actual product, drink or brand project. Clear specifications, samples and approval targets help your team work from the same brief.

How should we assess approval dates before choosing a model?

Separate design and sample approval from production and transit. Ask what starts each milestone and which approvals can stop it; a single headline lead time does not describe every development route or destination.

What should the quotation and sample review include?

For custom cup lead times: approval, production & transit, provide the use, model or reference, intended quantity and the information needed to review approval dates, production milestones and shipping scope. Identify essential requirements and undecided items so the quote and sample review address the same brief.

How should a fixed project date be handled?

State the required arrival date and destination at the start. We will assist you with artwork or design, sample approval, production and transit milestones separately. We will help you review the timing impact of any change to an approved specification; service scope and timing need project confirmation.
